given: an employee record linked to an organization membership
then: the employee record, its shifts, leave requests and payslips remain, active and readable; ending the employment is a separate act (HR-S1-29)
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-01: a Staff Member's record is still there, active, when their membership is revoked; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-01: and so are their shift and their leave; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-01: employee record outlives membership revocation

given: a worker employed at a Property who has no user account or login
when: an HR manager registers their employee record
then: the record is created with a null user and takes part in the rota, leave and payroll like any other
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-02: an employee record exists with no user and starts active; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-02: employee can exist without system login

given: a Staff Member holding hr.view in an Organization
then: every employee of that Organization they reach is listed, those still employed first, and no other Organization's
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-03: a manager reaching the Organization reads all six of its employees, the one with no Property included; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-03: hr.view reads the directory; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-03: list employees returns organization staff

given: an employee registered in Organization A
when: a Staff Member of Organization B reads or writes employees
then: nothing of Organization A is returned, and nothing is written into it
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-04: another Organization's employees are not read; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-04: and none is written into it

given: a Staff Member lacking hr.view and hr.manage
when: they query employees, shifts, leave or payroll
then: the row-level policies return no row
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-05: a Staff Member without hr.view reads no employee; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-05: no shift and no leave request either; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-05: without hr.view there is no run to read; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-05: hr queries without permission are denied

given: a Staff Member holding hr.view only
when: they try to register an employee, assign a shift, request leave or write a payslip
then: each write is refused by policy and nothing is created
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-06: hr.view alone does not register an employee; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-06: nor change one; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-06: nor write a payslip; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-06: nor assign a shift; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-06: nor request leave for someone; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-06: someone with hr view alone reads and changes nothing

given: an employed employee in an Organization
when: an HR manager sets their shift for a date
then: the shift is Morning, Evening, Day or Off with default start and end times; assigning again the same day changes it; a malformed time, or a Property the employee is not assigned to, is refused
test_name: hr.test.ts: HR-S1-07: assigning shift updates rota

situation: One shift per employee per date
given: an employee with a shift on a date
when: a second shift for the same date is inserted
then: refused by the unique key on the employee and the date
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-08: a second shift for one employee on one day is refused by the unique key

given: an employed employee with a pending leave request
then: the status moves from pending to approved, and an audit record at the employee's Property names who decided
test_name: hr.test.ts: HR-S1-09: approving leave updates status and is audited

given: two employees in one department
when: one has pending or approved leave and the other's pending request shares days with it
then: the manager sees a clash flag on the pending request; a different department, or days that are not shared, are not flagged
test_name: hr.test.ts: HR-S1-10: overlapping leave flags clash

given: an employee with a gross pay
then: every figure is an integer count of minor units, rounded half up once, and the parts add up to the gross exactly; the rates themselves are placeholders (HR-S1-28, HR-DEF-03)
test_name: hr.test.ts: HR-S1-11: every payslip adds up to the minor unit; hr-module.test.ts: HR-S1-11: a gross of 35,000 is split exactly; hr-module.test.ts: HR-S1-11: for every gross, the parts add up and nothing is fractional

situation: Approve payroll for the whole Organization
given: an Organization-wide manager and active employees at several Properties and at none
then: the run covers every active employee hired by the period's end, with one payslip each, totals equal to the payslips' sums, who and when it was approved, and payroll.approved emitted once
test_name: hr.test.ts: HR-S1-12: approving payroll covers every property as an organization wide manager

given: any employee, run or payslip
then: refused: there is no delete policy and no delete grant on any HR table
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-13: an employee cannot be deleted; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-13: nor a payroll run; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-13: nor a payslip; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-13: every HR policy is for ranza_app and none is for DELETE; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-13: ranza_app holds no DELETE on any HR table

given: an Organization with no employees
then: an empty state with one way to register staff
test_name: hr-view.test.tsx: HR-S1-14: hr screen renders empty state

given: an approved payroll run
then: a drawer shows gross, each deduction and net in the run's currency from minor units, and the masked IBAN
test_name: hr-view.test.tsx: HR-S1-15: payslip drawer displays breakdown

given: the HR screen
when: it is viewed in English, Turkish or Arabic
then: all copy renders in the selected language, direction mirrors in Arabic, and every refusal is worded from the catalogue
test_name: hr-view.test.tsx: HR-S1-16: hr screen supports all locales and rtl

given: the HR screen
then: the header carries a back link to Today that keeps the active Property, in every language
test_name: hr.spec.ts: HR-S1-17: the HR screen has a back button to Today that keeps the Property

situation: A leave request is decided once
given: a leave request that is approved or rejected
then: refused, and nothing more is recorded
test_name: hr.test.ts: HR-S1-18: a leave request is decided once

given: an employee with approved leave
when: another request of theirs over some of the same days is approved
then: refused by the exclusion constraint, and the module names it as overlapping leave
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-19: approved leave over days already approved is refused by the exclusion constraint; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-19: declining leave is audited and overlapping approval is refused

given: an employee record naming a Property
when: the Property belongs to another Organization
then: refused by the composite key, even for the table owner
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-20: another Organization's Property is refused by the composite key, even for the table owner

situation: Deleting a Property keeps its employees
given: a Property with employees
then: the employees stay, unassigned, in the same Organization; the key nulls the Property and nothing else
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-21: deleting a Property nulls the employee's Property and nothing else; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-21: the key says which column it nulls

situation: A Staff Member who reaches one Property
given: a manager holding hr.manage and assigned to one Property
when: they read or write HR records
then: they read and change only that Property's employees, shifts, leave and payslips; the same writes at another Property are refused
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-22: reads only the employees of the Galata Hotel; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-22: and only its shifts; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-22: and only the leave of its employees; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-22: registering an employee at a Property they do not reach is refused; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-22: so is a shift there; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-22: and changing an employee there matches nothing; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-22: and deciding their leave; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-22: a property scoped manager reads and writes only their property; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-22: a scoped manager decides leave only where they reach

given: an Organization whose Subscription is suspended, whose HR Entitlement is revoked, or whose Property has HR switched off
when: a Staff Member registers an employee, assigns a shift, requests leave, opens payroll or reads employees
then: each write is refused and each read returns nothing at the Property or Organization the gate closes; past due is a grace period and does not stop it
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-23: with every gate open, a manager registers an employee; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-23: a suspended Subscription stops an employee being registered; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-23: and payroll being opened; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-23: and a shift being assigned; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-23: and leave being requested; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-23: and a read carries the gates too, so a lapsed Organization reads no employee; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-23: past due is a grace period and does not stop it; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-23: a Property that has not switched HR on cannot take an employee; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-23: but another Property that has can; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-23: an Entitlement the Subscription does not include stops it; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-23: every HR write policy carries the commercial gates; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-23: and every HR read policy does; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-23: a lapsed subscription stops payroll and registration

given: a manager assigned to some Properties
when: they read, open or approve a payroll run
then: refused: a run has no Property to narrow to, so it takes reach to the whole Organization as well as the permission; the module names the reason, the screen says why, and no run is written
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-24: a manager of one Property cannot read a payroll run, which has no Property to narrow to; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-24: nor open one; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-24: nor write a payslip; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-24: but reads the payslips of the employees they reach; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-24: hr.view with reach to every Property reads the runs; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-24: but hr.view does not open one; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-24: every payroll run policy asks for reach to the whole Organization; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-24: a property scoped manager cannot approve payroll; hr-view.test.tsx: HR-S1-24: says why instead of showing a run it may not read; hr.spec.ts: HR-S1-24: a manager who reaches one Property is told payroll is the whole Organization's, and is offered no approval

given: an approved payroll run and its payslips
when: any role changes, reverts, deletes or adds to them
then: refused for every role including the table owner; restating the approval changes nothing and emits no second event
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-25: the application role cannot revert an approved run, because the update policy matches only drafts; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-25: even the table owner cannot change its totals; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-25: nor revert it to a draft; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-25: nor touch one of its payslips; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-25: nor delete one; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-25: nor delete the run; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-25: nor add a payslip to it; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-25: the definer that writes the outbox has an empty search_path; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-25: an approved run cannot be changed by the application

given: an employee record naming no Property
when: a manager who reaches one Property reads, registers or moves someone into that state
then: refused: such an employee is the whole Organization's, so it takes whole-Organization reach
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-26: an employee with no Property is the whole Organization's, so a manager of one Property cannot register one; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-26: nor move one out of their Property into the whole Organization; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-26: and cannot read one

given: a period that is approved, or two managers approving it at the same moment
then: one run, one payroll.approved event and one audit record; the second caller is given the approved run
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-27: approving a run emits payroll.approved once, in minor units and its currency; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-27: nor approve it again; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-27: restating an approved run changes no row, even for the table owner; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-27: and emits no second event; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-27: approving payroll twice is one approval; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-27: two approvals at once make one run

given: the payroll screen and a payslip
then: the screen says the social security, income tax and stamp duty figures are placeholders pending the owner and an accountant and must not be used to pay anyone
test_name: hr-view.test.tsx: HR-S1-28: payroll screen marks deductions as placeholder

given: an employed employee, with or without a system login
when: a manager ends their employment on a day not before they were hired
then: the status becomes terminated with the day, the record, shifts, leave and payslips stay and stay readable, an audit record is written at their Property, and any membership is untouched
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-29: an employee is terminated by a status and a date; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-29: and the record is still there and readable; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-29: a termination without a day is refused by a check; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-29: nor one before the day they were hired; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-29: terminating an employee keeps the record and its payslips; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-29: terminating before the hire date is refused; hr-view.test.tsx: HR-S1-29: terminating an employee keeps the record and its payslips

situation: The IBAN never leaves the server whole
given: an employee with an IBAN
when: any employee or payslip is returned
then: only the country and the last four digits are returned; the whole number is stored and never sent
test_name: hr.test.ts: HR-S1-30: iban is masked on the server; hr-module.test.ts: HR-S1-30: is shown as the country and the last four; hr-view.test.tsx: HR-S1-30: shows what it was given and has no number to reveal

given: an employee with approved leave over a whole period
when: payroll for that period is approved
then: they are in the run: being on leave is a leave request and not a status the run skips
test_name: hr.test.ts: HR-S1-31: approved leave does not stop pay

given: a gross pay that is fractional, negative or too large to hold exactly
then: refused, and no HR table holds a numeric money column
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-32: a negative amount is refused; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-32: no HR table holds a fractional amount; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-32: every amount is a bigint count of minor units; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-32: an amount that is not whole minor units is refused; hr-module.test.ts: HR-S1-32: an amount that is not whole minor units is refused; hr-actions.test.ts: HR-S1-32: more decimals than the currency has is invalid, and nothing is called

given: employees paid in two currencies
then: refused with its reason and no run is written; the database also refuses a payslip in another currency than its run's
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-33: a payslip for an employee paid in euros cannot join a run in lira; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-33: a run in two currencies is refused and says so; hr-view.test.tsx: HR-S1-33: a blocked draft explains itself and offers no approval

given: a currency that is not an ISO 4217 code
when: an employee is registered or their row is written
then: refused; an employee's currency is not in the update grant, so it is never restated
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-34: a currency code that is not three capitals is refused; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-34: and an employee's currency is not in the update grant, so it is never restated; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-34: a currency that is not one is refused; hr-module.test.ts: HR-S1-34: accepts ISO 4217 codes and nothing else

situation: A run's totals are its payslips' sums
given: a draft run whose totals differ from its payslips, or that has none
then: refused; a payslip whose parts do not add up to its gross is refused as well
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-35: a run with no payslips cannot be approved; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-35: totals that are not the sum of the payslips are refused; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-35: a payslip whose parts do not add up is refused

situation: Opened as a draft, approved once
given: a payroll run being written
when: it is inserted already approved, or approved in another person's name
then: refused for every role; a run moves from draft to approved once and names who approved it
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-36: the application role cannot insert a run as approved, because status is not in its insert grant; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-36: a run is opened as a draft; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-36: a payslip is inserted and never updated, so it has no update grant; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-36: approving as somebody else is refused; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-36: a draft whose totals are its payslips' is approved, by the person approving it; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-36: even the owner cannot insert a run already approved

given: an employee registered or terminated, leave decided, payroll approved
then: an audit record is written in the same transaction at the employee's Property (none for a run, which has no Property), naming ids, enums and counts and never a name, a salary or an account number
test_name: hr.test.ts: HR-S1-37: registering and terminating are audited at the employees property

given: the employee and run status columns
then: refused by the check constraints: neither can be reached, so neither is left dangling
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-38: on_leave is not a status, so nothing can be left dangling in it; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-38: a run is a draft or approved, and there is no paid

given: a terminated employee
when: someone makes them active, moves the day they left, or gives them a shift or leave
then: refused; re-hiring is a new record, because the old one is what payslips and the audit trail point at
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-39: a terminated employee cannot be made active again; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-39: nor have the day they left moved; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-39: a terminated employee stays terminated and takes no new work

given: an employee hired after the period ends, or one who has been terminated
when: payroll for the period is approved
then: they are not in the run
test_name: hr.test.ts: HR-S1-40: an employee hired after the period or terminated is not in its run

given: an Organization with no active employee hired by the period's end
then: refused, and the screen shows the draft as having nothing to pay
test_name: hr.test.ts: HR-S1-41: payroll with no employees is refused

situation: An unexpected failure is reported, not shown
given: a command that fails for a reason the module did not raise as a refusal
then: the screen shows a plain error carrying nothing the server said, and the failure is reported with who and where; a refusal or a bad input is an answer and is not reported
test_name: hr-actions.test.ts: HR-S1-42: an unexpected failure is reported and shown without its message

given: an employee with a blank email, or leave that ends before it starts
then: refused by a check constraint
test_name: hr.test.sql: HR-S1-43: leave that ends before it starts is refused by a check; hr.test.sql: HR-S1-43: a blank email is refused by a check; hr.test.ts: HR-S1-43: a leave request ending before it starts is refused

situation: The main flow, in a browser
given: an Owner on the HR screen
when: they register employees, end one's employment and approve a period
then: the people appear, the leaver stays on the screen as having left, the run covers the Organization and is locked, and the payslip opens with the IBAN masked
test_name: hr.spec.ts: HR-S1-44: an Owner registers an employee, ends another's employment, and approves payroll for the whole Organization

given: an approved payroll run
when: someone wants to record that it was paid
then: deferred: paying is a movement of money (a bank file, a transfer) that is not built, so there is no paid status; adding one is a decision, not a gap to fill in passing

given: an approved payroll run
then: deferred: payroll.approved is emitted and nothing consumes it; posting payroll to the General Ledger needs an adapter and accounts that ADR 0042 does not yet define, and is its own lane

given: the social security rate and ceiling, the income tax rate and the stamp duty rate
then: the figures in deductions.ts are placeholders carried over from the first version, not approved rules; the owner and an accountant decide which rules apply, and replacing that one function is the whole of the change

given: an Organization with Properties in more than one country
then: deferred: a run is in one currency and a mixed period is refused (HR-S1-33); one run per currency would make the key (Organization, period, currency) and the screen a list of runs

given: an employee hired or terminated mid-period, or on unpaid leave
then: deferred: a run pays the full gross of everyone it covers; pro-rating, a final payment for someone who left mid-period and a deduction for unpaid leave are payroll rules the owner has not decided

given: a Property that is archived
when: someone edits or ends the employment of its employees
then: deferred: an archived Property is unreachable everywhere, so its employees are read and paid by whole-Organization reach but cannot be changed until they are reassigned; reassigning needs the Property reachable

given: an employee's bank details
then: deferred: nothing needs it until a payout exists (HR-DEF-01), so no path returns it; if one is added it takes its own permission and an audit record

situation: Its own permission for approving payroll
given: a role that may manage HR
then: approving takes hr.manage and whole-Organization reach, as the ticket says; whether it deserves a permission of its own, as reversing a charge got one in ADR 0041, is the owner's decision

given: a leaver with a pending leave request
when: a manager looks at the leave list
then: the request stays pending and cannot be decided, and the screen says they have left; whether it should be closed automatically is the owner's decision
